summary: This joint resolution expresses support for designating the week of February 2, 2026, through February 6, 2026, as "National School Counseling Week" to honor school counselors' contributions and raise awareness of their role in student success.

scores.thoughts: This bill expresses support for designating 'National School Counseling Week' and highlights the important role of school counselors. While it acknowledges issues like student-to-counselor ratios and budget cuts, it does not propose any spending changes or policy shifts regarding public school funding. Its focus is on recognition and awareness, not financial allocation.
